ValidationRule.description: The rep's side of an instalment sale ends at Closed Won, which needs an instalment plan signed off by the Head of Finance and a down payment recorded by Finance. From then on Finance tracks the plan (US-03, US-05, US-15, US-17, US-29).
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Won"), OR(ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(StageName)), ISPICKVAL(Payment_Mode__c, "Instalment"), OR( Signed_Off_Plans__c = 0, Down_Payment_Received__c <= 0 ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: An instalment opportunity can only be closed once Finance has recorded the down payment and the Head of Finance has signed off the instalment plan. Keep it at Payment Arranged until both are done.
